analysis.title: Europe Multi-Industry: What Global Capacity Utilization and Leasing Data tell us about Multi-Industry
key_insights: Capacity utilization is treated as a leading indicator for capex. Latest prints show sequential gains in the EU and China, while the US was flat. Only the US sits at median levels, with the EU and China materially below.
GS reads the China and Europe data cautiously for the sector, citing elevated manufacturing inventories versus through-cycle levels in the China team's proprietary inventory survey.

US industrial capacity utilization is flat at 76% in Oct-26 versus 75.9% in Sep-26 and remains at 24-year median levels. Iron and Steel, Metals and Machinery improved most, while Electric Equipment, Aerospace and Paper fell.

In the US, Machinery shows more positive sequential trends than Electric Equipment, with both above median. Electric Equipment utilization fell to 85.6% from 86.3%, a surprise that may relate to higher employment.

EU industrial capacity utilization is 78.4% in 4Q26 versus 77.9% in 3Q26, below the 24-year median for 15 quarters. 10 of 12 categories improved, led by Trailers/Semi-Trailers, Basic Metals and Machinery, while Pharma fell.
EU Machinery and Electrical Equipment both improved sequentially, but remain below historical median levels.

China industrial capacity utilization is 73.1% in 3Q26 versus 73.0% in 2Q26, below median. Coal Mining, Electric Machinery and Power/Gas/Water improved, while Automobile Manufacturing and ferrous/nonferrous metals fell most. GS calls the read negative for local demand and for China competition risk in Europe and other EMs.
US Equipment Leasing and Financing momentum improved in Nov-26 for Construction Machinery (positive Volvo, CNH), Agricultural Machinery (positive CNH) and Medical Equipment (positive Siemens).

Leasing momentum fell for Transportation Equipment (negative Daimler, Traton, Volvo, Alstom, Siemens), Energy & Electrical Equipment (negative ABB, Siemens, Schneider, Legrand, Prysmian) and Industrial Equipment.
US payroll trends improved in Electrical Equipment, Non-Resi Construction and Metal Mfg and slowed most in Resi Construction, Mining and Truck Transportation (negative Daimler, Traton, Volvo).

Indeed postings rose in US Production & Mfg and Electrical and Industrial Engineering, Germany Construction and Production, and France Industrial Engineering and Production. They fell in Germany Electrical Engineering and France Construction.
Stock correlations with capacity utilization are highest for SKF Industrial, ABB Electrification and Sandvik Machining. Correlations with US employment are highest for Signify, Sandvik and SKF.
